title: Lagos's people, 1975 to 2050
about: Lagos's residential population at every fifth year from 1975 (GHS-POP R2023A, the European Commission's JRC, CC BY 4.0), on a grid of 1 km, read as a field that moves and grows. The Population view draws it year by year; the plan below learns its laws as a fluid's (growth, spread, drift toward the centre, crowding), judges each on 2015 and 2020 kept aside, finds the record's modes, and runs a law on to 2050 with its currents of people. Each epoch is the JRC's estimate from the censuses then available; 2025 and 2030 are its projections. A run is what a law does if nothing else changes, not a forecast of the place.
